# Background Sound: Faceless Content

> NICHE LOCK: this file applies only to **Faceless Content** (`faceless-content`). When composing for this niche, use only
> this profile and these recipes. Never use sound guidance from another niche's file.

## 1. Sound profile

Sound for faceless channels: voice-over facts, stories, history, mysteries, motivation, top-10 lists and
explainers over B-roll. With no face on screen, the **music carries the emotion**, so it matters more here than in any
other niche. It must create atmosphere and curiosity while the narration leads.

- **Tempo:** 60 to 90 BPM for stories, mysteries and documentary; 85 to 100 for facts and lists; up to 140 half-time
  for high-energy motivation edits.
- **Scales:** minor, phrygian and dorian for mystery and tension; major and lydian for wonder and positive facts.
- **Signature sounds:** dark ambient pads, pulsing low drones, ticking hats, cinematic swells, lo-fi beats for
  study-style facts, clean phonk-style rhythms (no vocals) for motivation edits.
- **Avoid:** bright corporate pop, ad-style jingles, cluttered melodies that fight the narrator.
- **Arc:** tension under the question, a reveal moment (impact or drop), calmer resolve under the CTA.

## 2. Genres used in this niche

- **Dark ambient**: 60 to 75 BPM, minor / phrygian, kit electronic; moods: mysterious, suspenseful, dark, curious, serious
- **Mystery suspense pulse**: 70 to 90 BPM, phrygian / minor, kit electronic; moods: suspenseful, mysterious, curious, tense
- **Lo-fi study beats**: 72 to 88 BPM, dorian / minor / major, kit lofi; moods: calm, cosy, focused, curious, nostalgic
- **Documentary cinematic**: 64 to 84 BPM, minor / major, kit acoustic; moods: serious, emotional, reflective, epic
- **True-story heartbeat**: 60 to 72 BPM, minor, kit electronic; moods: tense, emotional, serious, mysterious
- **Sci-fi ambient**: 70 to 92 BPM, lydian / minor, kit electronic; moods: futuristic, curious, dreamy, awe
- **Clean phonk-style rhythm (no vocals)**: 130 to 145 BPM, phrygian / minor, kit 808; moods: bold, gritty, energetic, edgy, determined
- **Dark trap half-time**: 130 to 142 BPM, minor / phrygian, kit 808; moods: dark, bold, intense, serious
- **Epic orchestral-style**: 80 to 100 BPM, minor / major, kit acoustic; moods: epic, triumphant, inspiring, bold
- **Retro synthwave**: 96 to 112 BPM, minor / dorian, kit electronic; moods: nostalgic, dreamy, bold, retro
- **Meditative drone**: 60 to 70 BPM, lydian / major / dorian, kit electronic; moods: calm, reflective, peaceful, wise
- **Soft horror tension**: 60 to 76 BPM, phrygian / minor, kit electronic; moods: creepy, tense, suspenseful, dark
- **Curious facts groove**: 88 to 100 BPM, major / dorian, kit electronic; moods: curious, playful, light, friendly

## 3. Recipe format

`ID | genre | tempo | key and scale | mood | kit and drum feel | bass | pad | lead | fx | best for`

Kits, pads, leads and bass values map directly to the CreatorLab renderer (see core/sound.md, section 9).
